title: Kapable's "Self Made": An Aggressive and Dark Trap Anthem
htmlContent:
Kapable, a rising star in the hip-hop scene, has released his latest track, "Self Made." The 21-year-old artist, originally from Waynesboro, PA, shows off his production, writing, and performing skills in this original song.

The track boasts an aggressive and dark tone, perfectly matched with a hard-hitting instrumental featuring a trunk-shaking bass, bouncy percussion, and kicking beats. The raw and unfiltered energy of the track is a testament to Kapable's musical influences, with Mac Miller being one of his biggest inspirations.

"Self Made" is a must-listen for trap and rap music fans, offering a glimpse into Kapable's unique style and undeniable talent. The track reflects his journey as an artist, which he has pursued relentlessly since his early years in Kentucky. With "Self Made," Kapable cements his position as an artist to watch in 2023 and beyond.
